bureau: Credit Information Register (Central Bank of Samoa)
note: The Credit Information Register Act 2026 (2026, No. 4, assented 25 August 2026), the Legislative Assembly of Samoa's English text, linked from its Bills, Acts and Regulations page (palemene.ws) and read in full. It establishes a national Credit Information Register administered by the Central Bank of Samoa, to which banks and the other liable reporting entities in its Schedule report. Section 20(2)(d): credit default information on a debtor's default may be kept 5 years from the date of default, and s.20(1) has the Central Bank remove it when the period ends: written as keep 5. Account information stays 5 years from the account's closure (s.20(2)(c)); no shorter period for a default later paid is set, so the form's clears isn't used. Section 16 has entities report at the prescribed intervals, or those the Central Bank approves; none is stated in the Act, so the days to report are the game's reading: the next monthly update. Section 1(2): the Act commences on a date the Minister nominates (items 2 to 6 of the Schedule later); no notice of the date was found on the Central Bank's site (its news page, read 2026-10-31) or Parliament's, so whether the Register is yet operating wasn't confirmed. The Samoa Observer's report of the third reading (19 August 2026) states the same five years.

sources.title: Legislative Assembly of Samoa: Credit Information Register Act 2026 (2026, No. 4), English text
sources.said: AN ACT to provide for the establishment of a national Credit Information Register to be administered by the Central Bank of Samoa. [25th August 2026] ... (2) This Act (except for items 2 to 6 of the Schedule) commences on a date to be nominated by the Minister. ... 20. Retention of credit information-(1) The Central Bank may retain information on the Register for the periods set out in subsection (2) and must remove information at the expiry of those periods. ... (c) for credit account information, 5 years from the date of closure of the account; (d) for credit default information relating to default by the debtor, 5 years from the date of default; ... (b) at the prescribed reporting intervals or, if none is prescribed, at the reporting intervals approved by the Central Bank.

sources.title: Samoa Observer: Credit register bill passes final reading (19 August 2026)
sources.said: Samoa's Parliament passed the Credit Information Register Bill 2026 on its third and final reading on Wednesday. ... Most identification, application, account and default information may be kept for five years, although retention periods vary according to the type of information.
